scheduled_effects.note: The bill from Munich falls due: Bavaria's claim on command, compensation, and the Palatine electorate hardens into a debt the crown cannot refuse.
Wallenstein's army, raised so easily, now feeds itself off the land without waiting for the emperor's leave — and grows a power beside the throne.
The heads left on the Charles Bridge become a Protestant memory that no later mercy can wash away.
The Edict's commissioners reach the Protestant north; the alarm they raise becomes the recruiting-sergeant of the Swedish war.
